subject: Urgent: NorthBridge onsite workshop — request to reschedule
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@northbridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@northbridge.com>
Date: 2026-04-11T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Need to move Wednesday workshop — weather + exec conflict

Hi Soojin and Laura,

Quick update from our side — two things came up that mean we can’t host the onsite workshop as planned this Wednesday (4/14):

1) Severe weather is forecast for the region that day (Metro alert says flights & ground transit may be disrupted).
2) Our CEO was just called into an unexpected board meeting on Wednesday afternoon; they need to be present for a portion of the session.

We still want to make this happen in person. Can Redwood move the session to one of these windows?
- Friday 4/16 (all day)
- Monday 4/19 (morning preferred)
- Wednesday 4/21 (flexible)

If we do Monday, we’d like to start 09:00 and keep to a tighter agenda (exec slot 10:30–11:15). We’ll need a parking pass for the CEO’s car and a short list of attendees on your side for security check-in.

Apologies for the late notice — the board calendar shifted today. Let me know what works and if Redwood can cover any last-minute change fees for travel/hotel.

Thanks,
Maria
Maria Gomez
Head of Product Programs, NorthBridge Financial
+maria.gomez@northbridge.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@northbridge.com>, Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@northbridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-11T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Need to move Wednesday workshop — weather + exec conflict

Thanks for the heads up, Maria — totally understandable. We can be flexible.

Options from Redwood:
- We can move to Monday 4/19 and start at 09:00 (fits your exec slot).
- If you prefer Friday 4/16 we can run a condensed agenda but Marcus will need additional time to prepare the model rollouts and ensure GPU pool reservations.
- Wednesday 4/21 also works, but we’d prefer earlier in the week to avoid travel churn.

We’ll cover reasonable change fees. I’ve attached an updated agenda (workshop-agenda-v2.pdf) and my flight change receipt stub (soojin-flight-itinerary.pdf) for bookkeeping.

A few quick asks so we can lock logistics:
- Confirm final date/time and executive attendance window.
- Provide the final attendee list for Security/Front Desk.
- Confirm whether you want us to bring a demo GPU node onsite (Marcus can bring a high-memory A40/A100 machine if needed).

Laura/Marcus/Evelyn — can you confirm team availability for Monday 4/19 09:00–16:30 if we lock it? Marcus — flag any infra prep you need.

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-11T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: NorthBridge reschedule implications

Team — quick internal note so we’re aligned before we confirm with Maria: 

- If we move to 4/16: Marcus will need to re-run the long pre-prod tests tomorrow night to ensure the demo is stable; that eats into his weekend. Also travel change fees likely minimal if flights are after 24hrs.
- If we move to 4/19: we need to confirm Evelyn’s CS coverage for the afternoon (post-workshop follow-ups) and Marcus should reserve an extra A100 node in Dedicated for the demo (CS ticket CS-4221).
- Parking pass / security: I’ll request a vendor pass from their facilities once we have the final attendee list.

Evelyn — can you take the post-workshop RACI if we do Monday? Marcus — put a hold on extra capacity for 4/19 and confirm whether A100 or A40 (I think A100).

Thanks — I’ll be ready to update travel if Soojin confirms the date with Maria.

Laura Bennett
Director, Solutions Sales, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@northbridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@northbridge.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T14:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Need to move Wednesday workshop — weather + exec conflict

Thanks, Soojin — quick update from our side. The board meeting is now confirmed for Wednesday and Friday looks tight for a couple of our execs. Monday 4/19 is the best fit for everyone — can we lock that?

Confirmed ask: Monday 4/19, start 09:00, end by 16:30. Exec slot 10:30–11:15. Please send the final list of Redwood attendees and someone from your engineering team who will lead the demo. Also: we need a parking pass for the CEO (small SUV) and a visitor badge pre-created.

We appreciate covering reasonable change fees for the hotel; I’ll forward the hotel invoice after we rebook and we’ll route expenses through procurement.

Date: 2026-04-12T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Monday 4/19 onsite workshop — Redwood logistics

Maria — great, Monday 4/19 is locked on our side. Thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming logistics below: 

- Date/time: Monday, April 19, 2026 — 09:00 to 16:30 (exec slot 10:30–11:15).
- Redwood attendees: Soojin Lee (Sales), Laura Bennett (Solutions Lead), Marcus Lin (Solutions Engineer), Evelyn Hart (Customer Success).
- Demo lead: Marcus Lin — he’ll bring an A100 host for the onsite demo and will run a warmup at 07:00 that morning.
- Parking/Badges: please share the name on the CEO’s vehicle and preferred arrival time; Laura will request a vendor parking pass and pre-created visitor badges.
- Travel/hotel: Redwood will reimburse reasonable change fees — Maria please forward invoices to finance@northbridge.com and cc laura.bennett@redwood.com; we’ll handle internal approvals.
- Follow-ups: Evelyn will run the post-workshop action tracker and send an initial list of deliverables by EOD Tuesday.

Links / attachments: workshop-agenda-v2.pdf (attached), CS ticket: CS-4221 (infra hold for A100).

If anything changes I’ll escalate immediately, but otherwise see you Monday morning. Safe travels.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0189
